provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pax Renaissance 2nd ed. rules (Sierra Madre Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: These steps follow the 2nd edition rules
steps.note: The 1st edition opens this guide too; the 2nd edition added components such as Pawns and squares

steps.text: Black disks on Timbuktu and Novgorod, white disks on the Spice Islands and the Red Sea
No gameboard: lay the 10 starting Map cards (marked with a small diamond) in a 2 x 5 grid
1550 variant: Reformist England and Reformist Holy Roman Empire Map cards on those Empires
One Token of the shown shape and colour in each Empire's capital (name in capitals); Constantinople gets 2 green Knights and a green Rook
Deal Player Boards at random; each sets theirs in front of them (East cards go right, West left)
Starting Pawns: Fugger in Augsburg, Medici in Florence, Coeur in Alexandria, Marchionni in Lisbon (only for banks in play)
Your other 9 Pawns into your Reserves
East deck: 12 random East cards shuffled with the 2 East Comets, then {n} more random East cards on top
West deck the same way with West cards and the 2 West Comets
Astrology variant: turn the top card of each deck faceup (not for sale)
Deal 6 East cards in a row on the board and flip the one furthest from the deck facedown (the trade fair); same for West
The 10 Empire squares King side up next to their Empires
The 4 Victory squares on the board, inactive side up
Each turn: 2 actions, then refresh the market
Random first player (Fugger always goes first if in play)
Florins by seat: {f}; the rest go in China on the board
